title: GPU memory
description: Explicit GPU memory accounting. Unknown remains unknown, never 0. All values are bytes (Protocol 1.1.0 clarification; the published fixture and every known producer use bytes). The capability-gated iw.gpu-memory family (specs/46, schemas/v1/resources/gpu-memory-*.json) is the detailed superset; specs/46 §11 maps each field here onto it. `reserved` is logical and never part of a physical total.
